verdict.rationale: Replicate documents Cog, its own first-party packaging tool for deploying custom models, as open source. That makes one component of the product readable, but nothing shows the core hosted platform's source is open. The many open-source models it hosts are community or third-party models, not Replicate's own source, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence that the core platform/API source is published, the specific open license named, a link to the source repository, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: you can deploy your own custom models using Cog, our open-source tool for packaging machine learning models
